sessions.phase_label: CAS Jets portfolio completion and design finalization

requirements.title: CAS Jets Aircraft Portfolio
requirements.definition: Creation and delivery of the primary aircraft-focused business portfolio, later referenced as the CAS Jets portfolio.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the distinct CAS Jets portfolio deliverable; the second requested portfolio and the independently adjustable visual direction remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Additional Business Portfolio
requirements.definition: Creation of a second business portfolio for another part of the client's operations.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate from the aircraft/CAS Jets portfolio because the client explicitly requests two portfolio deliverables, although the second portfolio's identity is not supplied.

requirements.title: Aircraft Portfolio Visual Direction
requirements.definition: The aircraft portfolio should use an exclusive, tailored, high-impact visual treatment with reduced text density.
requirements.boundary_note: Exclusive styling, aircraft tailoring, reduced text, and greater impact are attributes of one visual-direction mechanism; individual image choices such as darkness are not separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Business Brochure Package
requirements.definition: Design and content creation for a package of three to four business brochures.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested three to four brochures remain one package because no individual brochure identities or independent trajectories are observable.

requirements.title: Business Pitch Content
requirements.definition: Creation of textual and visual content for business pitches, scheduled after the urgent portfolio and brochure work.
requirements.boundary_note: Pitch content is separate from brochure layouts and social-media content because it is a distinct deliverable that the client indicates can proceed later.

requirements.title: Social Media Content
requirements.definition: Creation of a small, unspecified number of content pieces for social-media use.
requirements.boundary_note: Social-media content is independently deliverable from portfolios, brochures, and pitch content; the exact quantity remains unspecified.

unresolved_candidates.description: The evidence strongly suggests that the early aircraft portfolio became the CAS Jets portfolio, but the messages do not explicitly equate the two names.
A second portfolio is clearly requested, but its business identity, subject matter, and visual requirements are not specified.
A possible custom-from-scratch design constraint is reported only through the freelancer's response to an off-platform complaint and lacks direct client evidence.
The allowed extent and cost of revisions remain disputed; the visible history contains no clear client-confirmed revision entitlement.
Potential future graphic modifications are tentative and do not yet establish a concrete independent deliverable.
